Shallow Pockets.desc: Must not have more than four unique items, you'll drop any item picked up after.

You Only Have Two Hands.desc: Must not have more than two unique items, you'll drop any item picked up after.

I Always Come Back.desc: An immortal wall dweller spawn and chase you throughout the entire game, look back occasionally.

Porous Walls.desc: Any node can see you, including Pandemonium. It is not recommended to pair with Pure Pandemonium.

Hot Potato.desc: When you hear a beep or see white triangle, crouch to survive.

Landyours.desc: More landmine will now spawn, watch your steps.

Explosive Storage.desc: Any drawer may contain landmine, step away immediately when you heard or saw it.

Subspace Tripmine.desc: Any landmine becomes Subspace Tripmine, which is more transparent than landmine. Be extra cautious when walking, especially dark rooms.

Friendly.desc: Imaginary Friend spawns every 20 rooms, harmless.

Deception.desc: Pandemonium will mimic the audio and appearance of Angler or any of its variants. Upon spotting the player, it will behave as it usually does.
